description: The image displays two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), each representing proportional distributions of different categories, with both charts including percentage labels directly on their respective slices and a legend for color/pattern correspondence. Chart (b) contains four slices: the largest, at 38%, is blue with diagonal stripes; a 27% slice is pink with a dotted pattern; a 19% slice is yellow with a hatched pattern; and the smallest, at 15%, is gray with a dotted pattern. Both charts include legends positioned above them, mapping each pattern/color to its corresponding label — for chart (a), the labels are “the,” “this,” “for,” “to,” “in”; for chart (b), the labels are “the,” “$,” “equilibrium,” “constatant.” Neither chart has any visually emphasized slices (e.g., exploded or bolded), and the slices within each chart appear to be arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
